introText.default: DAO Music Entertainment is a leading music company driving innovation across Vietnam’s music industry.

col1Text.default: Founded in 2020, DAO Music Entertainment powers Vietnam’s first integrated music ecosystem offering comprehensive solutions spanning Music Distribution, Publishing & Licensing, Music Marketing, Music & Visual Production, Artist Development and Digital Media Network Solutions.

col2Text.default: We have collaborated with over 1,000 artists and supported more than 5,000 music projects, working closely with leading international and domestic labels and music companies. Our reputation as a trusted partner reflects our commitment to empowering artists and advancing the growth of Vietnam’s music industry.
